name: Near-Far Linear/Disparity Ray Generation with Stratification
aliases: Near-Far Linear Ray Generation with Stratification
definition: Generates sample points along camera rays for volume rendering by sampling z-values (depths) either linearly or in disparity space, with optional stratification to reduce variance.
summary: Near-Far Linear/Disparity Ray Generation with Stratification generates volume rendering samples using fixed geometric spacing in depth or disparity space, optionally applying stratification to reduce variance.
